patch_description: Revert to the empirically superior 2-parameter local-rotation scheme (independent theta_ry for a global RY layer and theta_z for a global RZ layer, score 0.61) rather than the theta_su-merged variant that regressed to 0.58 by collapsing per-qubit RY+RZ into one angle (losing per-qubit two-axis expressivity). On top of that proven base, enrich the entangling shells by inserting a CRX gate for every pair that already has a CRZ gate, reusing the SAME theta_z parameter (non-commuting X-axis controlled rotation added at zero extra parameter cost). This tests whether adding an orthogonal-axis entangling pathway (CRZ + CRX sharing one angle) improves worst-group margin/generalization without increasing the parameter budget beyond 2 circuit parameters (4 total with gain/bias), which the scoring rule rewards unconditionally.
